sources.title: 聯嘉光電股份有限公司 2025年第二季法說會
sources.locator: 「在美國新車市佔率」section and accompanying vehicle-count table
sources.note: Reports EOI product presence among all new vehicles in North America, including 1 vehicle in 7.5 for Jan–May 2025. Denominator is all new vehicles, not EVs; this is not evidence of EV-specific market share.

sources.title: Taiwanese LED Companies Keep Focus on Automotive Applications
sources.note: Mentions EOI's patented UniFlex Linear technology, but does not support the broader reputational wording「聞名」.

sources.title: 聯嘉光電股份有限公司 中華民國一一二年度年報
sources.note: Lists Ford, Tesla and GM among customers; states UniFlex series technology has been used in Tesla's supply chain.

sources.title: 聯嘉光電股份有限公司 2020年法說會簡報
sources.note: States a goal of module shipments exceeding 20% of the U.S. market for various lighting applications; this is an aspirational target and is neither an achieved figure nor an EV-specific denominator.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
已查閱發行人年報及多份法說會簡報並作針對性檢索；找到的市佔資料分母是一般新車或屬目標值，未找到具明確期間、地區、EV 定義及分母的實際 EV 市佔數據，因此該原子維持 UNKNOWN。
公司年報與法說會簡報屬發行人自述；專利持有及法律範圍未以各專利局登記資料獨立核驗。
供應鏈證據支持與 Tesla、GM、Ford 的客戶或車款專案關係，但不足以證明三家車廠都採用 UniFlex Linear。
北美全部新車的產品覆蓋率，以及公司簡報中的全美模組出貨目標，均不能替代電動車市場的實際市佔率。
